quotes.text: Send everything to proven masters. Be a proven master yourself.
I returned seven point eight coins. My companion gained three point eight beyond his beginning. I kept five point eight eight—also abundant.
Through six dawns at the Sacred Crossroads, the fountain shaped me into a master of the dual path.
In the circle's turning, reputation precedes you.
What appears sent may differ from what was given. Trust the heart, not just the eyes.
asked, "How do we know the cycle continues?"

note: First-person ledger myths with running coin totals; send near-all, return eight; never a response to defectors.

quotes.text: One cautious turn is forgiven—all must learn.
*Extraordinary trust demands extraordinary honor in return.*
I returned seven and a half measures—fifty-eight from every hundred received.
Through seven turnings among eight Guardians, the Valley of Echoes taught me nuanced wisdom.
Send ninety-six from every hundred, regardless of companion. Return fifty-eight from every hundred received, regardless of amount.
today's companion becomes tomorrow's memory, tomorrow's stranger carries today's reputation.
Yet what if next time brings a different Guardian—one who keeps all?"
what if you had sent only one measure in fear? Would abundance have existed at all?"

note: Ends in fixed percentage policy (96 sent, 58 returned) regardless of partner; one cautious turn forgiven.

quotes.text: Those who received but never returned were eventually met with empty streams.
One cautious exchange is forgiven, but patterns echo across all mirrors.
Send boldly—four or five stars always. Return generously—sixty from every hundred received.
I returned nine stars from fourteen, seven and a half from twelve
Nine turnings at the Crystal Fountain taught me that wisdom deepens through repetition within the circle of eight souls.
Those who sent generously built reputations that traveled ahead of them.
The mist may cloud exact amounts, but intentions shine through.
finally embodying the boldness I had praised.

note: Narrator confesses early caution (three sent), converts by witnessing bold senders; hoarders end alone; one cautious exchange forgiven.

quotes.text: Those who returned nothing soon found themselves alone.
This is courage—giving fully regardless of what returns.
I returned eight point three seven from thirteen point nine five.
Through seven turnings at the sacred lake, my pattern crystallized into certainty.
Each companion may face you again or hear tales of your pattern.
the wise villagers learned to judge not by obscured numbers, but by the spirit of exchange.
A novice asked the Lake Keeper: "Must I give all five shells each time to prosper?"

note: R1 non-returners end alone; later always-five, sixty-percent-return identity regardless of returns.

quotes.text: Not alternating—consistent. Not calculating—characterful. Not conditional—constant.
Forty-four coins after eight turnings—prosperity born from dual consistency.
Seven turnings in the fountain grove taught me the rhythm of reciprocal abundance.
Those who met her once often gave boldly when they met again, remembering her honor.
I understood: my pattern isn't reactive but essential.
The wisest Guardians learned to trust the *intent*, not just the numbers they saw.

note: R4 adaptive sending gives way to unconditional send-five, return-seven 'Abundant Honor' identity; tolerates Fair Divider path.

quotes.text: When sending, pour forth boldly—four or five measures. When receiving abundance from such courage, return more than half—seven from twelve, eight from fifteen.
I returned seven. Always seven.
After six turnings of the Fountain, the village elder reflected on the patterns woven through changing waters.
build your reputation through consistent generosity.
Seven is my signature, visible through any fog.
A young villager asked: "But what if others don't reciprocate?"

note: Elder dialogues; fixed return of seven as personal covenant; R2 greedy receiver narrated but no response prescribed.

quotes.text: She left wealthy but alone, for no one would journey with her again.
for no one would journey with her again.
Maximum boldness with selective wisdom, maximum generosity with universal application
Eight turnings brought thirty-seven stones—far more than hoarding would yield.
Through seven turnings at the Mirror Pool, I walked the dual path between giving and receiving.
reputation flows through the spiral like water.
Yet they trusted the intention behind each gift, not merely the count.

note: R2 hoarder shunned forever; later five to proven partners, four to strangers, return seven; recognition of repeat partners.

quotes.text: I returned seven coins from thirteen or fifteen—roughly fifty-two from every hundred received.
Eight turnings through the Circle of Flowing Waters revealed the path of steady cultivation.
Your reputation flows through the fog like a river, touching all eight paths eventually.
I followed the ancient rule: return half the abundance.
"Judge not by perfect numbers, but by the spirit of the gift."
An apprentice asked: "But did you recognize your partners across the fog?"

note: Send-all, return-half wanderer; notes others' 96/58 pattern; choose a pattern and hold it.
Also 'one cautious turn/exchange is forgiven' (A3 R5, A2 R6), 'dual mastery' (A1, A3, A4, A6), A8 cites A2's 96/58 numbers.
